milestones.name: Acquire Monarch Wings
milestones.note: Found at the end of the path after defeating Broken Vessel in Ancient Basin

milestones.name: Defeat Broken Vessel
milestones.note: Boss guarding the path to Monarch Wings in Ancient Basin

milestones.name: Forgotten Crossroads becomes Infected Crossroads
milestones.note: Triggered upon grabbing the Monarch Wings; increases enemy difficulty and blocks some paths

zones.name: Ancient Basin
zones.fingerprintHint: Dark cavern with hanging roots/tendrils, paid bench, spike corridors, infected goop blockade

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Early area that transforms into Infected Crossroads after Monarch Wings are obtained

zones.name: Infected Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Transformed version of Forgotten Crossroads with harder enemies and blocked paths

zones.name: Crystal Peak
zones.fingerprintHint: Upper area accessible with double jump (mentioned as example use case)

zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.fingerprintHint: Fungal core / central location mentioned as reachable with Monarch Wings

abilities.name: Monarch Wings
abilities.grants: Double jump; refreshed by landing on a surface or pogo-ing off an enemy's head
abilities.note: Requires Mantis Claw and Crystal Heart to reach. Triggers Infected Crossroads transformation on pickup.

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Prerequisite required before obtaining Monarch Wings

abilities.name: Crystal Heart
abilities.note: Prerequisite required before obtaining Monarch Wings; used to Crystal Dash across spike corridor in Ancient Basin

bosses.name: Broken Vessel
bosses.note: Encountered in an infected corridor blocked by goop; must be defeated to open the door leading to Monarch Wings. Shown as a massive shadowy creature looming over the Knight in the keyframes.

objectives.name: Sit at the paid bench in Ancient Basin
objectives.hopDescription: Locate and optionally unlock the bench at the bottom-left of Ancient Basin before proceeding
objectives.note: Costs Geo to unlock; recommended as a nearby respawn point

objectives.name: Cross the spike corridor using Crystal Dash
objectives.hopDescription: Use Crystal Heart's Crystal Dash ability to traverse the long spike stretch to the left of the bench
objectives.note: Beware spikes at the far end; spawns next to them if hit. Cannot return up the hole once descended.

objectives.name: Break the shortcut wall
objectives.hopDescription: After passing the Mks (enemies), take the path up-right and break the wall for a shortcut back to the bench

objectives.name: Defeat Broken Vessel
objectives.hopDescription: Approach the infected goop corridor to trigger the Broken Vessel boss fight and defeat it

objectives.name: Obtain Monarch Wings
objectives.hopDescription: Follow the path through the now-open door after Broken Vessel; collect Monarch Wings at the end
objectives.note: Picking this up immediately transforms Forgotten Crossroads into Infected Crossroads

connectors.description: Breakable wall shortcut connecting the Broken Vessel approach path back to the paid bench area
connectors.note: Must be broken by the player to open

connectors.description: Picking up Monarch Wings in Ancient Basin triggers the transformation of Forgotten Crossroads into Infected Crossroads
connectors.note: One-way event trigger; Forgotten Crossroads becomes permanently Infected Crossroads

connectors.description: Monarch Wings double jump unlocks access to the top section / Hive's Crown area of Crystal Peak
Monarch Wings enables access to the Fungal Core, a central location within Fungal Wastes
